title: Proof of Insurance Standard for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Standard.** When the vehicle program requires proof of insurance, an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements is marked insurance verified only after the buyer's insurance card or declarations page is received showing:
- the order's VIN;
- the buyer as a named insured; and
- an effective date no later than the scheduled handover date.

**Financed orders.** For an order paid through Kestrel Auto Finance or an outside lender, the proof must also show comprehensive and collision coverage with a deductible no higher than the program's financed insurance deductible maximum, and the lender as loss payee. Liability-only proof is not accepted on a financed order.

**Order status.** Insurance is verified only on an order whose status is reserved or contracted.

**What counts as proof.** The buyer's statement that a policy exists is not proof; only the insurance card or declarations page received counts.

**Checklist by payment type.**

| Item shown on the document | Cash order | Financed order (Kestrel Auto Finance or outside lender) |
|---|---|---|
| The order's VIN | required | required |
| Buyer as named insured | required | required |
| Effective date no later than the scheduled handover date | required | required |
| Comprehensive and collision coverage | — | required |
| Deductible no higher than the program's financed deductible maximum | — | required |
| Lender as loss payee | — | required |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A cash buyer of a Kestrel Inspected vehicle sends a declarations page naming the buyer and the VIN, effective two days before the scheduled handover date. The document meets the standard.
- A Kestrel Auto Finance buyer sends an insurance card with liability-only coverage. It is not accepted on a financed order.
- A financed buyer's declarations page shows collision coverage with a $1500.00 deductible, above the $1000.00 financed deductible maximum that applies under every program. It is not accepted.
- A buyer whose order is already delivered sends proof. Insurance is not verified on a delivered order.
